contactForm.title: Send us a message
contactForm.lead: Your message goes straight to the team for its topic. We reply by email.

topic.error: Choose what your message is about.

safeguarding.label: Safeguarding concern
safeguarding.body: Please don't use this form for a child at risk. The safeguarding page explains who to call first.

name.label: Your name
name.error: Enter your name, in up to 100 characters.

email.label: Your email address
email.error: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.

subject.label: Subject
subject.error: Enter a subject, in up to 150 characters.

message.label: Your message
message.hint: Up to 5,000 characters. Please don't include bank or card details.
message.error: Enter your message, in up to 5,000 characters.

contactForm.privacy: We use what you send only to answer you, and delete it 2 years after we close your message.
contactForm.sent: Thank you. Your message is with our team. Your reference is {reference}, and we have emailed it to you.

alerts.human_check_failed: We couldn't confirm that a person sent this. Please press Send again.
alerts.rate_limited: You've sent several messages in a short time. Please try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, or email us.
alerts.rate_limited_hours: You've sent several messages today. Please try again in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}, or email us.
alerts.failed: Something went wrong and your message wasn't sent. Please try again, or email us.
